meta.Feature: FEAT-RDF-26 ACE DB additions (ACE team)
meta.Priority: Must - critical path for the 30 November release
meta.Depends on: None. This story is first on the recovery critical path
meta.Blocks: RWB-E1-069, RWB-E1-002, RWB-E1-016, RWB-E1-018, every Tier 2 feature
meta.Status: Ready for the ACE team estimate (DL43)
meta.X1: A source file fails its trailer or checksum | The ingestion writes no row for that source and business date; `ace_batch_run` keeps the previous COMPLETED row as the latest | AC3
meta.X2: A field in appendix A has no column after the migration | The conformance test fails and names the field ID | AC8
meta.X3: A source re-sends a business date already loaded | The unique business key rejects the duplicate; the batch record keeps one row for that source and date | AC7
meta.X4: A new column would change an existing ACE column type | The migration is rejected at review; new columns are additive only | AC1, AC6
meta.X5: The view-owner role is granted more than SELECT | The grant check fails the security review | AC4
meta.X6: The migration must be backed out | The down script drops the 14 tables and the 12 columns; no ACE row is touched | AC5
meta.Independent: Needs nothing from the recovery module; it is the first item on the critical path
meta.Negotiable: The field list is fixed by appendix A; the ingestion design is the ACE team's choice
meta.Valuable: Removes 14 tables and a load estate from the Workbench, and gives ACE one more complete source set
meta.Estimable: 14 tables, 12 columns, 14 ingestion jobs, one grant, one conformance test
meta.Small: One migration plus the ingestion jobs; the ACE team sizes it in DL43
meta.Testable: Eight criteria, each one automated test
meta.BR1: Every table carries `source_system`, `business_date` and `loaded_at`; the business date is the source business date, not the ingest date | D-RCV-35 U2; E1-015
meta.BR2: Every table has a business key with a unique constraint; the Workbench links by that key and never by a generated id | D-RCV-35 U4
meta.BR3: New columns on existing ACE tables are additive only; no existing column is renamed, retyped or dropped | D-RCV-35 U3
meta.BR4: The batch record is one row per source and business date, written even when the source delivers zero rows | E1-015; E1-016
meta.BR5: Selective grant: the view-owner role reads the listed tables and writes nothing | D-RCV-35 U4; CTL-02
meta.BR6: A field is in this story only if the Workbench needs it; a field the Workbench does not read is not added | appendix A
meta.Who: What they may do in this story
meta.ACE team lead: Owns the story, the estimate and DL43
meta.ACE DBA: Applies the migration and the grant
meta.View-owner role: Selects the 21 listed tables; writes nothing
meta.Recovery squad: Reads the views only; has no grant on a public table
